be accompanied by fever: This kind of flu is often accompanied by fever and a sore throat, so drink plenty of water.
這種流感常伴隨發燒和喉嚨痛，所以要多喝水。
accompany a singer on the piano: My music teacher was invited to accompany a singer on the piano at the school concert.
我的音樂老師受邀在學校音樂會上為一位歌手鋼琴伴奏。
accompany the report with charts: Please accompany the report with charts so that readers can see the sales numbers at a glance.
請在報告附上圖表，讓讀者一眼就能看出銷售數字。
accompanied by heavy rain: The typhoon arrived at midnight, accompanied by heavy rain and strong winds that knocked down trees.
颱風在午夜抵達，伴隨大雨和吹倒樹木的強風。
accord with the facts: The witness's story does not accord with the facts, so the police believe he is lying.
證人的說法與事實不相符，所以警方認為他在說謊。
accord someone respect: In many cultures, people accord someone respect simply because that person is older.
在許多文化中，人們僅僅因為某人年紀較長就給予他尊重。
be accorded a warm welcome: When the gold medalist returned home, she was accorded a warm welcome by thousands of cheering fans at the airport.
那位金牌得主返鄉時，在機場受到數千名歡呼粉絲的熱烈歡迎。
acknowledge a mistake: A good leader is not afraid to acknowledge a mistake and apologize to the team.
好的領導者不害怕承認錯誤並向團隊道歉。
acknowledge receipt of a letter: Please send a short email to acknowledge receipt of a letter from our office as soon as it arrives.
收到我們辦公室的信件後，請盡快寄一封簡短的電子郵件確認收到信件。
acknowledge someone's help: At the end of her speech, the writer took a moment to acknowledge her editor's help with the book.
在演講結尾，作家花了一點時間感謝她的編輯對這本書的協助。
be widely acknowledged as: Taipei 101 was once widely acknowledged as the tallest building in the world.
台北101曾被公認為世界最高的建築。
acknowledge defeat: After losing the final game by twenty points, the team captain had to acknowledge defeat and shake hands with the winners.
在決賽輸了二十分之後，隊長只好認輸，並與獲勝者握手。
acquire a skill: It takes years of practice to acquire a skill like playing the violin well.
要習得像拉好小提琴這樣的技能，需要多年的練習。
acquire a taste for coffee: I hated the bitter flavor at first, but I slowly acquired a taste for coffee during my college years.
我起初討厭那苦味，但大學時期我逐漸愛上了咖啡。
acquire a reputation: Through years of hard work, the small bakery has acquired a reputation for the best bread in town.
經過多年努力，這家小麵包店已獲得鎮上最好吃麵包的名聲。
acquire a company: The tech giant plans to acquire a company that makes smart watches for two billion dollars.
這家科技巨頭計畫以二十億美元收購一家製造智慧手錶的公司。
acquire knowledge: Reading widely is one of the best ways to acquire knowledge outside the classroom.
廣泛閱讀是在課堂外獲取知識最好的方法之一。
adapt to a new environment: It took my cat several weeks to adapt to a new environment after we moved to a bigger apartment.
我們搬到較大的公寓後，我的貓花了好幾週才適應新環境。
adapt a novel for film: The director spent two years trying to adapt a novel for film, cutting many scenes to make it two hours long.
導演花了兩年把一本小說改編成電影，刪掉許多場景使其長度為兩小時。
adapt the recipe: My sister is allergic to nuts, so I adapted the recipe by using sunflower seeds instead.
我妹妹對堅果過敏，所以我改用葵花籽來調整食譜。
adapt to climate change: Farmers in the south are planting new kinds of rice to adapt to climate change and longer dry seasons.
南部的農民正種植新品種的稻米，以因應氣候變遷和更長的乾季。
address the issue: The principal promised to address the issue of bullying at the next school meeting.
校長承諾會在下次校務會議中處理霸凌的議題。
address the audience: Before the concert began, the band leader stepped up to the microphone to address the audience with a short speech.
音樂會開始前，樂團團長走到麥克風前，以一段簡短的致詞向聽眾演講。
address someone's concerns: The doctor took time to address my mother's concerns about the side effects of the surgery.
醫生花時間回應我母親對手術副作用的疑慮。
address the needs of students: The new program was designed to address the needs of students who have trouble reading.
這項新計畫是為了滿足有閱讀困難的學生的需求而設計的。
address a letter to: Be sure to address a letter to the right department, or it may get lost in the company mailroom.
務必把信寄給正確的部門，否則它可能會在公司收發室裡遺失。
adjust to city life: Having grown up on a quiet farm, Tom found it hard to adjust to city life in noisy Taipei.
在安靜的農場長大的湯姆，覺得很難適應吵鬧台北的城市生活。
adjust the plan: Since the museum was closed on Monday, we had to adjust the plan and visit it on Tuesday instead.
因為博物館星期一休館，我們只好調整計畫，改在星期二參觀。
adjust one's attitude: If you want to get along with your new classmates, you may need to adjust your attitude and be more open.
如果你想和新同學相處融洽，你可能需要調整心態，變得更開放。
adjust prices: Because the cost of eggs went up, many breakfast shops had to adjust prices last month.
由於雞蛋成本上漲，許多早餐店上個月不得不調整價格。
